description: This file defines schema-related constants, types, and functions for managing buckets in etcd's storage backend, including bucket definitions, key names, and utility functions.

classes.name: bucket
classes.description: Represents a storage bucket with an ID, name, and safe range property.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the bucket's name as a byte slice.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the bucket's name.

methods.name: IsSafeRangeBucket
methods.description: Indicates whether the bucket is a safe range bucket.
